entries.text: What are you doing? Please take your seat.[VAR 0x0114(0013)]
entries.label: champ_0180_stopper_01

entries.text: I, Rika, will be your interviewer.[VAR 0x0114(0013)]
entries.label: champ_0180_ground_03

entries.text: Let’s get started with the first portion of the\nChampion Assessment.[VAR 0x0114(0013)]
entries.label: champ_0180_ground_04

entries.text: First things first—let me see how many Gym\nBadges you have...\c\nExcellent! You have all eight![VAR 0x0114(0013)]
entries.label: champ_0180_ground_06

entries.text: Next, I’d like to ask you a few questions, if you\nwouldn’t mind, [VAR 0x0100(0000)].[VAR 0x0114(0013)]
entries.label: champ_0180_ground_07

entries.text: Please think carefully, as you may automatically\nfail the interview depending on your answers.[VAR 0x0114(0013)]
entries.label: champ_0180_ground_08

entries.text: How did you get here today?[VAR 0x0114(0013)]
entries.label: champ_0180_question_01

entries.text: Please tell me the name of the school you are\nenrolled in.[VAR 0x0114(0013)]
entries.label: champ_0180_question_02

entries.text: So, what brings you to the Pokémon League\ntoday?[VAR 0x0114(0013)]
entries.label: champ_0180_question_03

entries.text: I came to become a Champion
entries.label: champ_0180_select_03b

entries.text: Yes, indeed. Why else would you be here,\nI suppose.[VAR 0x0114(0013)]
entries.label: champ_0180_ground_12

entries.text: Now, what do you intend to do if and when you\nbecome a Champion?[VAR 0x0114(0013)]
entries.label: champ_0180_question_04

entries.text: I want to become even stronger
entries.label: champ_0180_select_04a

entries.text: Tell me: Which of the eight Gyms gave you the\nmost difficulty?[VAR 0x0114(0013)]
entries.label: champ_0180_question_05

entries.text: And what was the name of the Gym Leader you\nfaced there?[VAR 0x0114(0013)]
entries.label: champ_0180_question_06

entries.text: I’m glad you seem to remember.[VAR 0x0114(0013)]
entries.label: champ_0180_ground_15

entries.text: But do you remember which type of Pokémon\n[VAR 0x0100(0001)] used?[VAR 0x0114(0013)]
entries.label: champ_0180_question_07

entries.text: Building the skills needed for the Champion\nAssessment is no small feat.[VAR 0x0114(0013)]
entries.label: champ_0180_question_08a

entries.text: You must have met a lot of Pokémon to get\nhere, [VAR 0x0100(0000)].[VAR 0x0114(0013)]
entries.label: champ_0180_question_08b

entries.text: What was the category of the Pokémon you\nchose to be your first partner?[VAR 0x0114(0013)]
entries.label: champ_0180_question_08c

entries.text: Now, please forgive me, but I’m going to repeat\na previous question.[VAR 0x0114(0013)]
entries.label: champ_0180_question_09a

entries.text: Remind me, what do you intend to do if\nand when you become a Champion?[VAR 0x0114(0013)]
entries.label: champ_0180_question_09b

entries.text: I want to become even stronger
entries.label: champ_0180_select_09a

entries.text: Next is the final question for this interview.[VAR 0x0114(0013)]
entries.label: champ_0180_question_10a

entries.text: One of the staff will let you know the results.\nThank you again for your time.[VAR 0x0114(0013)]
entries.label: champ_0180_failed_03

entries.text: Now, regarding the results of the interview\nportion of your Champion Assessment...
entries.label: champ_0180_staff_02

entries.text: I’m sorry to say you didn’t pass.
entries.label: champ_0180_staff_03

entries.text: Just between you and me, I’ve heard they won’t\ninterview you seriously until you have all eight\r\nGym Badges.
entries.label: champ_0180_staff_06

entries.text: You can take the Champion Assessment as many\ntimes as you want.
entries.label: champ_0180_staff_04

entries.text: I hope you come back for another try soon!
entries.label: champ_0180_staff_05

entries.text: Thank you very much for your time today.[VAR 0x0114(0013)]
